account: This node's product is the steelman material — the strongest counterarguments to the kitsch charge, each with its honest concession and the rebuttal that remains. This is not a sequential drafting stage; the three strongest counterarguments are genuinely independent analytical threads, each self-contained and drawn from the writer's own reasoning (no external sources). Running them in parallel lets each be developed deeply, then reconciled here into a single nuanced objection-and-concession resource that the final essay's thesis can absorb. I deliberately expand rather than solve so each argument gets its own rigorous treatment and the reconciliation is explicit.

children.acceptance_condition: Returns a three-part write-up labeled (a) strongest plain form, (b) honest concession, (c) surviving rebuttal, in essay-register prose, each part at least a few sentences and grounded in the 'kitsch-as-gatekeeping' direction.
children.expected_contribution: A finished, reusable steelman block on the gatekeeping objection with its concession and rebuttal, ready for synthesis.
children.no_future_sibling_dependency: It relies only on shared context (thesis direction, audience, genre) and on general reasoning about cultural gatekeeping; it needs no sibling's output.
children.objective: Develop the counterargument that accusing AI art of kitsch is historically a gatekeeping move made against new media and popular taste. Produce (a) the strongest plain-language form of the argument, (b) the concession a nuanced essay must honestly grant, and (c) the rebuttal that remains available to the thesis.
children.rationale: This is one of the two or three strongest independent objections and is analytically self-contained: it works entirely from cultural history and the sociology of taste, needing nothing a sibling produces.
separator_facts: Stance posture: defended, nuanced thesis; neutral survey out of scope (decision:2).
Plain essay prose, no citations or named theorists required (decision:3).
No source materials provided; reasoning only.
Provisional thesis anchor: whether AI art is kitsch is not settled by the medium — intent, use, and specific qualities decide it.
Counterargument domain: kitsch accusation as a historical gatekeeping weapon against new media and popular taste.

decidability.account: All context needed to assess the steelman children is present: audience, genre, stance posture (defended, nuanced thesis; neutral survey out of scope), form constraints, and the four candidate counterargument directions listed in the objective. No workspace sources are required; the node is reasoning-only. Acceptability of each child is mechanical (strongest form present, concession stated, surviving rebuttal stated) and checkable on return. Children need no sibling's future output.

synthesis_contract.acceptance_condition: The synthesis yields at least two (target: three) distinct counterarguments, each clearly carrying (a) strongest plain form, (b) honest concession, (c) surviving rebuttal; the concessions form a bounded, coherent set that deepens rather than dissolves the thesis; and the package is written in register consistent with the shared invariants and economically capturable in the 550–650 word final essay.
synthesis_contract.conflict_policy: If children's concessions accidentally contradict each other (e.g., the sincerity argument concedes AI cannot be sincere while the intention argument claims curation supplies intention), the parent reconciles by distinguishing the artist's externally supplied intention from the work's internally expressed sincerity, and by ranking arguments: lead with the strongest (gatekeeping), support with curation, and treat the sincerity misfit as the most contestable, to be conceded most heavily.
synthesis_contract.parent_question: Which two or three counterarguments give the essay's thesis its strongest opposition, and what must each be conceded versus rebutted so the final essay is genuinely nuanced?
required_contributions: counter-gatekeeping: three-part write-up (strongest form / concession / surviving rebuttal) on kitsch-as-gatekeeping
counter-intention: three-part write-up on curation-as-taste supplying the intention kitsch lacks
counter-sincerity: three-part write-up on the sincerity requirement fitting AI art only by simulation, plus the non-sentimental/non-formulaic range of AI output
shared_invariants: All three write-ups assume the provisional thesis: whether AI art is kitsch is not settled by the medium; intent, use, and specific qualities decide.
Each counterargument keeps its strongest plain-language form intact — a steelman is useless if it is weakened to be beatable.
Each concession is stated honestly and precisely; concessions that fully defeat the thesis are avoided in favor of real but bounded qualifications.
Register stays plain essay prose; no citations required.
Length awareness: the synthesized steelman must be subsumable within the 550–650 word total essay, so each block should be economical.
